digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center comment sanitization and truncation
propositions: rebar hardcodes comment ceiling at 32767 characters, but Jira Data Center admins can configure jira.text.field.character.limit to a different value between 0 (unlimited) and 2147483647, causing silent data loss when comments exceed the hardcoded limit but fall within the instance's configured limit

the constant WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT is reused for both description and comment truncation, creating a structural coupling that could cause future changes to description fitting logic to incorrectly retarget comment truncation
comment ceiling must be made configurable via ReconcilerConfig, defaulting to 32767, to allow operators to override the hardcoded value and prevent silent truncation on instances with raised limits
comments longer than 32767 characters but shorter than an operator-configured ceiling should be transmitted in full without truncation, verified by unit test
comment sanitization must be decoupled from the description fitter function to prevent description-specific logic (such as ADF-size measurement in Cloud) from being applied to comments
